info.title: Zigbee gateway API
info.description: Implemented v1 API. Additive response fields are allowed. Proposed dashboard configuration APIs are documented separately.

gateway_host.description: Replace with the board's reserved LAN address.

400.description: Invalid or ambiguous event cursor query

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Single decimal cursor; no additional query parameters. Reset to zero when boot_id changes (restart or sequence epoch rollover).

post.description: No automatic retries. A timeout can mean the request executed. No delivery or state confirmation.

503.description: Offline, not ready, busy, or stack rejected

post.description: Available only when built with CONFIG_GW_NETWORK_TEST. Temporarily uses an unavailable SSID, restores configured credentials autonomously. Does not reset Zigbee. No automatic use by the dashboard.

400.description: Invalid request or test already active

404.description: Test feature disabled in this build

network.description: Wi-Fi recovery counters, link/IP/API state, backoff/progress times, disconnect/reboot reasons and opt-in test state. No credentials.

type.description: Unknown future event types must be retained and ignored by projections.

payload.description: Validated model-specific payload; no arbitrary vendor writes.
Validated model-specific payload; no arbitrary vendor writes.

Command.description: A request is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. 202 confirms stack acceptance only.
